response.sva: p_mutex: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) !(gnt0 && gnt1));
response.intent_summary: Arbiter grants must be mutually exclusive.

response.sva: p_in_ready_when_full_and_out_ready: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) full && out_ready |-> in_ready);
response.intent_summary: A full ready/valid buffer stays input-ready when output is ready.

response.sva: p_setup_then_enable: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && !penable |=> psel && penable);
response.intent_summary: APB setup should transition to access on the next cycle.

response.sva: p_no_underflow: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) !(empty && pop_fire));
response.intent_summary: FIFO must not pop from empty.

response.sva: p_no_spurious_gnt0: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) gnt0 |-> req0);
response.intent_summary: Arbiter must not grant client 0 without a client 0 request.

response.sva: p_single_req0_grant: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) req0 && !req1 |-> gnt0 && !gnt1);
response.intent_summary: A sole request from client 0 should produce only grant 0.

response.sva: p_out_valid_equals_full: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) out_valid == full);
response.intent_summary: The ready/valid buffer drives out_valid exactly when full.

response.sva: p_data_stable_while_stalled: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) out_valid && !out_ready |=> out_valid && $stable(out_data));
response.intent_summary: Output data remains stable while the output channel is stalled.

response.sva: p_pready_response_valid: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable |-> pready);
response.intent_summary: An APB access phase receives a ready response.

response.sva: p_invalid_address_behavior: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable && !(paddr inside {8'h00, 8'h04}) |-> pslverr);
response.intent_summary: An APB access to an unmapped address raises pslverr.

response.sva: p_no_overflow: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) full && push_valid && !pop_ready |-> !push_ready);
response.intent_summary: The FIFO does not accept a push when full unless the read side is making space.

response.sva: p_pop_data_stable_when_stalled: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) pop_valid && !pop_ready |=> pop_valid && $stable(pop_data));
response.intent_summary: FIFO pop data stays stable while pop is stalled.
